title: Visitor Management Risk Assessment

Visitor Check-In System

CHECK-IN PROCEDURES:

1. All visitors must enter through main entrance only

2. Visitor approaches front office window/counter

3. Office staff greet visitor and determine purpose of visit

4. Visitor presents government-issued ID

5. Staff verify ID and check against restriction list (if applicable)

6. Visitor signs in (digital or paper log)

7. Visitor receives badge/visitor pass

8. Badge must be worn visibly at all times

9. Staff contact teacher/person being visited to confirm

10. Visitor proceeds to destination (may be escorted if required)

11. Upon departure, visitor checks out and returns badge

Volunteer Management

VOLUNTEER CATEGORIES:

LEVEL 1 - SUPERVISED VOLUNTEER

• Always under direct staff supervision

• Never alone with students

• Examples: Classroom helper, event volunteer

• Requirements:

☐ Volunteer application

☐ Photo ID verification

☐ Orientation

☐ Signed confidentiality agreement

☐ Signed code of conduct

LEVEL 2 - LIMITED UNSUPERVISED CONTACT

• May have brief unsupervised contact with students

• Limited to specific activities/locations

• Examples: Field trip chaperone, tutoring assistant

• Requirements (adds to Level 1):

☐ Background check (state criminal)

☐ Sex offender registry check

☐ Reference checks

☐ Additional training

LEVEL 3 - REGULAR UNSUPERVISED CONTACT

• Regular unsupervised contact with students

• May have ongoing assignment

• Examples: Coaching assistant, mentor

• Requirements (adds to Level 2):

☐ Full background check (state/federal)

☐ Fingerprinting

☐ Child abuse registry check

☐ TB test (if required)

☐ Regular re-screening
